faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our process

timeline.question: How long does a website take?
timeline.answer: Timeline depends on your package. Starter: 1-2 weeks, Growth: 2-4 weeks, Pro Max: 4-6 weeks. We'll provide a detailed timeline after our discovery call.

technical.question: Do I need to know anything technical?
technical.answer: Not at all! We handle all the technical aspects. You just need to provide content, images, and feedback. We'll guide you through everything.

language.question: Can you work in my language?
language.answer: Yes! We can build websites in any language. Just let us know your preferred language during the discovery call.

changes.question: What if I want to change things later?
changes.answer: All packages include support. You can request changes, and we'll handle them. Growth and Pro Max packages include more comprehensive update support.

ownership.question: Will I own my website?
ownership.answer: Yes, you own your website. We build it for you, and it's yours. You can move it to another host if needed (though we recommend staying with us for support).
